    # Identify the filled rectangular frame and its inner rectangle. Expand
    # the inner color as an outer border around the original frame.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pts = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v != 0]
    if not pts:
        return out
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    # The enclosing rectangle color is on perimeter; interior color seeds a

    outer = grid[r0][c0]

            if r < r0 or r > r1 or c < c0 or c > c1:
                out[r][c] = inner
    return out
